highlights.text:
Insistence on preserving capital, or, secondarily, on limiting the portfolio's volatility,
calls for an emphasis on defense, which precludes pursuing maximum growth.

highlights.text:
Correspondingly, a decision to strive to maximize growth requires an emphasis on offense,
meaning preservation of capital and steadiness must be sacrificed to some degree.

highlights.text:
You can't simultaneously emphasize both preservation of capital
and maximization of growth, or defense and offense.
